description: Master Services Agreement (MSA) governing the framework relationship between a customer and a service provider. Captures parties, term, payment terms, and key risk-allocation clauses.

agreement_title.instruction: Title of the agreement as stated on page 1

execution_date.instruction: Date last party signed, if different from effective date

customer_name.instruction: Legal name of the customer / client

provider_name.instruction: Legal name of the service provider

termination_for_convenience_notice_days.instruction: Days of prior written notice required to terminate for convenience

payment_terms.instruction: Payment terms (e.g. Net 30 from invoice date)

late_fee_rate.instruction: Late fee or interest rate on overdue amounts

liability_cap.instruction: Cap on aggregate liability (e.g. fees paid in prior 12 months)

consequential_damages_waived.instruction: Whether consequential / indirect damages are mutually waived

ip_ownership.instruction: Who owns deliverables and pre-existing IP

confidentiality_term_years.instruction: Number of years confidentiality obligations survive

assignment_allowed.instruction: Whether assignment is permitted without consent (other than affiliate / change-of-control)
